summary_en: This work develops a non-contact Fabry-Perot acoustic detection system for imaging subsurface micro-defects from laser-induced ultrasonic signals. It combines optical ultrasound sensing with an adaptive weighted wavelet singular spectral entropy feature-imaging algorithm and validates detection of 0.2 mm defects in aluminum alloy. The direct optical generation and optical detection of acoustic waves, followed by defect-image formation, place it squarely within the repository's acoustic-optics imaging scope.

summary_en: This paper presents a physics-aware, thickness-only acoustic hologram framework for generating high-fidelity multi-focal ultrasound fields through the skull. Rather than optimizing an ideal phase mask and converting it afterward, the method directly produces fabrication-ready holograms while accounting for transcranial propagation. Simulations, skull experiments, and in vivo validation show improved focal reconstruction, energy confinement, and reduced off-target leakage. Although the application is neuromodulation rather than diagnostic imaging, the central contribution is acoustic holographic field synthesis and reconstruction, making it a strong core acoustic-holography entry.
